balls.text: full on the stumps, he backs away and drags it to wide long on, and comes back for two
loopy slower one, he charges out and adjusts to slap it to long off
gets across to sweep from outside off, can;t connect, takes the leg bye to short fine
full, reverse swept to backward point
he almost hit this for another six, Wright's serial bombing of an innings is over, he's slammed this length ball to long on, just inside the rope
slow length ball, he pings extra cover with a punch
full toss swung to deep midwicket's left for two more
he scored only two last ball, and he makes up for it with a swipe for maximum over deep midwicket, is this happening for real
gaps all around the field for Mr Wright who heaves wide of deep midwicket now
Luke Wright gets his sixth successive boundary, this is incredible, wide yorker now, he steers it to third man, who lets it slip through, atrocious
he's only hitting boundaries, what a start, full and wide again, Wright hammers it over extra cover and it beats three chasing men to roll into the boundary
swinging away full, and too wide
walks outside off to heave to leg, but misses the full one and is hit on the pad
four on the trot, Luke Wright, where have you been, heaved past long on into the deep midwicket boundary this time
Luke Wright starts his IPL batting stint with three successive boundaries, lifts a pitched up ball straight and between the chasing fielders from long off and long on
slow length ball around off, Wright waits and slaps it wide of sweeper cover
first ball he faces in the IPL, Wright swings a full one into the deep midwicket boundary
Gilchrist went for the non-striker's end from behind the stumps, and almost hit, Smith went for the single after chopping it over the stumps
Mahmood strikes first ball on return, Yuvraj tries to heave a length ball, leading edge swirls over extra cover, who judges it well
back of a length, climbing on off, beats the swing with the bounce
Yuvraj mistimed the pick-up off the pads this time, but it fell just short of deep square leg
good length, just outside off, and Yuvraj has smashed that into the sightscreen powerfully
goes full but drags it too wide
short outside off, and he misses the pull now
slower length ball now, and Yuvraj is hit on the pad outside leg
Yuvraj gets going early in the over, back of a length around off and he's dispatched it over deep midwicket
turns this length ball angled across, with a late steer, to third man
works a length ball on off to long on
gets across and squeezes a length delivery outside off to point
Yuvraj has mishit this pull high in the air, it's come down at  midwicket, which is vacant
length ball outside off, he gets a leading edge to sweeper cover
he's found sweeper cover, backed away to a shortish ball on leg stump and smashed it straight to the fielder, Gony is charged up
full into the pads now, worked through midwicket
angles it full and wide from over the stumps, Finch cannot connect as he reaches out
turns a length ball off pad to square leg
pitched up and Yuvraj goes after it, but hits the drive to deepish mid off
gets down and tries to lift an overpitched ball over extra cover, mistimes it to the sweeper
backs away and has a go at a length ball, just hits it wide of extra cover, and just beats the sweeper's dive
coming in from a good length, on middle, pushed back
shortish, widish, hurrying across Yuvraj, and he steers it between point and short third man
forward to a tossed up ball to push to sweeper cover
outside off, dabbed to short third man
overpitched down the pads, and swept high over deep backward square leg, rubbish line
comes down the track, Chawla shortens it, it pops up off the pad as Yuvraj pushes with bat and pad together
on the pads, rolls behind square on the leg side
across to turn a length ball to short midwicket
slow length ball turned to deep midwicket
short into the body next ball and Finch pulls it easily to the deep square leg rope
shot, Finch gets to fifty as Pune captain, picks a length ball from off and murders it over deep midwicket
yorker just outside off, Yuvraj digs it out and scampers for a single, has to run around the bowler
pushes a back of a length ball going across, to extra cover
flighted quicker on middle and leg, nudged off the front foot fine down leg
slides in with the angle on a good length, he backs away and gets bat down in time to cut for one
goes across and works a length leg break behind square leg
tossed up, he comes forward to block
gets width on a length and cuts to the backward point boundary, easy
tossed up outside off, driven to sweeper cover
gets across and punches a length ball from the crease to mid off
good length, close to off, leaving him on the angle, he lets it go
widish full toss, reaches out and thick inside-edges to midwicket
Gilly's made no mistake this time, Uthappa tried to slash a length ball swinging away a tad, and thick-edged it to the keeper
another short ball, and another pull, Gony has more work, to his right now, he does better this time, keeps them to two
Awana drops it short on return, and is pulled to deep midwicket, Gony does well to dive, but he;s ended up parrying into the rope, and long on cannot reach in time
bounce now from a good length, cut to the sweeper
gets down for the sweep, and places it to the left of short fine leg
slides on from a good length, punched to extra cover
overpitched, he slogs it down to long on
short, and wide, he backs away to slam it through extra cover, and beats long off too
steers a legbreak to short third
fuller again, pushed off the front foot to mid off
was staying in the crease, reflecting the kind of length Gony's bowled, but saw it pitched up for once, and pushed it awkwardly to off for one
slightly further up this time, and now Finch can get on top of it to cut into the ground and over backward point
beaten on the cut, Gony is getting extra bounce from short of a length
width on good length, and he flays it out to the sweeper
gets across to push a short of a length ball to extra cover
flat again and coming in now, to off, punched to wide long off
flat, slapped to extra cover again
skiddy and straightening outside off, cut to the sweeper
bat in front of pad to turn it through square leg
backs away for the cut, mistimes to extra cover
tossed up, pushed to long on
shortish, flat-batted over the bowler, long on runs across and dives, can't stop it
pushed towards point
beaten on the cut with lots of bounce from back of a length
Finch had given up, but this seems to be his night, charged out for the single after a push to mid off, had the throw hit, he would have been out by metres
back of a length, punched to extra cover for one
starts with a short of a length that gets big on the batsman, but he is not bothered much, puling it down into the deep square boundary
pushes it full on the stumps, he clips it nicely but straight to midwicket
slaps a length ball to extra cover
comes forward and pushes a length ball to the bowler
hit on the pad as he misses the work to leg, takes the single
almost popped it back, wanted to work this back of a length ball from off to leg, leading edge falls short of the bowler
length ball on off turned to the leg side
Uthappa charges out, and slices a straightening length ball over backward point
short of a length, punched from the crease to short extra cover
moves across and tucks a length ball past midwicket, placed wide of the man in the deep
good length again, angled into off, turned to midwicket
the ball is skidding when it hits that green patch in the middle, worked to leg
good length coming in on off, he nudges it to deep square leg
now Uthappa pushes a pitched up ball through the bowler's hands, mid off cuts it off, seriously poor stuff in the field
sloppy again, and it is Manan Vohra once more, a push to him at mid on, and he cannot pick it up cleanly
short into the body, Finch sends it to the deep square leg with a confident pull
Finch finds the gap between point and backward point with another cut, one of them takes pace off it with a dive, Mahmood asks his team-mates to life their game
good length outside off, he is forward eagerly to take the single with a push in front of cover
how much is that drop going to cost, Finch gets four more with a short-arm pull through midwicket
that was quick and skiddy, nipped in after hitting the big green patch, Finch had no time to play that one, beaten totally as goes over the stumps
just back of a length, worked through midwicket
keeper and slip appeal for lbw as this hurries in to the pad from a length, sliding down leg
punches a length ball from the crease towards extra cover
back of a length, slight width, and Finch cuts it hard into the ground past backward point's dive, third man gets around
Mahmood ends an excellent over that will go down as 11 conceded with another edge, a thick one this time, as Finch goes pushing at a pitched up ball, runs past slip
gets worse from Kings now, Finch drives to mid off's left, that should have been stopped really, right through him as he tumbles to his left
Finch hits back, front foot out to a length ball and hammers it straight and high
swinging away wider, left alone

oh dear, Gilchrist has dropped the simplest of chances, Mahmood produces a thin edge with one holding its line from a good length, Finch pushing half-forward, Gilchrist's keeping has been his stronger suit easily this IPL, not this time
on target right away, good length, angled in just outside off, straightening, pushed back
still quite wide from PK, moving further away, he cuts it to point
swinging away but too wide, and Uthappa carves it over point
skids and moves down the leg side as it hits the huge green patch in the middle of the pitch
moving away from a length, punched to mid off, who dives to save a few runs
that was there to be cut, came in but was still wide on a good length, Finch latched on, but hit it to point
turned wide of mid on

angled away and straightening widish outside off, steered wide of third man, they come back for the second, a better throw would have tested Uthappa, PK lets the fielder know what he thinks of the effort
Miller's done it, Kings XI players rush onto the field, Miller's got a full toss and crashed it into the crowd over long off
low full toss mowed straight down the ground, Mandeep gets back quite safely
cracker jacker, Wright gets if full but not that wide, and Miller smashes it over the deep extra cover rope
very full and wide, Mandeep cannot make much of it, drives to extra cover
length ball outside off cut to deep point
low full toss outside off, sliced down to third man, Dinda ends his spell with more anger as Rahul Sharma allows a second, collects the weak throw and slams the ball hard into the ground
another full toss, he finds extra cover though, run out missed, Dinda was there to collect the throw, but messed it up, easy chance gone
very full, and he cannot get under it, hits it down to long on
overpitched and flayed along the ground to long off
successive full tosses for Dinda and successive fours for Miller, wider now and Miller slices it over point
Dinda starts with a full toss around off, and Miller powers it into the straight boundary
unfortunate end to a tight over, full and widish, Mandeep goes after it, and the thick edge flies past the keeper
goes hard at a full toss, but hits it to sweeper cover
swinging away a tad, full and widish, he cannot time the drive to extra cover
nice, widish and in the blockhole, Mandeep charges out and misses
full toss sliced behind point, Nayar runs across from third man and puts in the slide
walks across way outside off stump looking for the scoop over short fine, is hit on the pad with a wide one
superb over from Dinda, in the blockhole to end, he drags it in front of square leg for a couple
swipes a full toss to wide long on
pitched up and angled across, swings and slices it on the bounce to third man
pitched up outside off, swung straight to midwicket
yorker on the stumps, he backs away to dig it out behind point
low and wide full toss, does not get hold of it, pushes to extra cover
charges out and slices a full delivery over cover
fifty for Miller with a push to sweeper cover
just over the deep extra cover boundary, slower one outside off, Miller has enough room to crack it high
nice work by Finch, running across from long on and stopping a powerful straight hit on the bounce
overpitched, swung hard in the air, on the bounce to long off
picks it from well outside off and swipes to deep midwicket
low full toss, tries to paddle from outside off, top edge dies in front of the keeper down leg
slogged to the wide long on boundary, Wright slides in vain
around the blockhole, squeezed out to extra cover
hit straight down the ground, long on gets around
slower one bowled wide, produces the edge that falls inches short of Uthappa diving one-handed to his right
hit down to long on off the bottom edge
comes down, and swipes a flat one to long on
flat, shortish and on the pads, pulled hard in front of square leg
comes down the pitch and slaps it to the sweeper
cut wide of sweeper, whose throw is weak and Mandeep gets back for Kings XI's first fifty of the season
sees him coming out and drags it short, crashed down to long off
short and sitting up, lifted over the bowler, on the bounce to long off
again in the blockhole outside off, Miller misses, Dinda stares and has a few words to say
in the blockhole outside off, he misses
yorker on the stumps, dug out to short third, who misses with a wild throw and they take the overthrow to long off, Dinda is furious with Rahul Sharma's attempt, he is really angry
slowish length ball outside off, Mandeep's walked across and scooped it just over short fine leg
pitched up outside off, driven in the air to long off
full and angled across, too far wide
full toss outside off, driven wide of long off for two more
pushes a flat length ball tamely to extra cover
straightening on off, he makes room to cut to the sweeper
skips out, bat and pad to the leg side, rushes back
flat now, and wide too, Miller cuts to deep  backward point
over the Kings XI dugout now, Miller down the track and lofting a fullish delivery high and over long on
shortish and pulled to deep midwicket
Wright misses, Miller was gone had he hit, tried to take a leg bye close to the pitch on the on side, Wright got there quickly, but missed with the lob
beaten on the cut
nice, he's beaten extra cover with a drive in the air, and hit it powerfully enough
good length ball skidding on, swiped to deep square leg
angled wide, thick inside edge to the leg side, Wrigth rushes at it, but slips as he slides
starts on the pads with a length ball, Mandeep can;t get hold of the swipe
into the Kigs XI dugout beyond the long on boundary as Miller comes out and gets hold of a length ball
lofts a tossed up ball in the air to long off
works a length ball off pad to deep square leg
goes back and whips in front of square leg
comes out, takes it on the full, slices it straight to short third
walks out, he shortens it, and is cut to the sweeper
tossed up full, hits down to long on
pitched up, lofted down to long on
forces it to extra cover
full on middle, turned in the gap through midwicket
reaches out to loft this with the turn over extra cover, Smith reaches there from long off in time with a slide
quick and short again, swatted to long on
bit of width as this turns away, cut to sweeper cover
shortish and quick on the pads, turned in front of square leg
full and coming in, worked to deep midwicket
tossed up and going across, pushed to long off
skips out and pushes a length ball back to the bowler
tossed up, defended to short extra cover
short, and down the pads, but he;s one worked it to fine leg for one
gone, they were going so well, and Vohra has thrown away another start, floated up too full for the slog sweep, Vohra on the knee for the swipe, misses, and Yuvraj is too accurate to miss
drives to the right of sweeper cover for a couple
goes back to a length delivery angled in and works it square on the leg side
tossed up slowly, defended off the front foot
goes back to a skiddy pitched up delivery and works square to leg
full toss now, he steps out and heaves into the deep midwicket boundary
flat and quick on off, pulled to deep midwicket
gets down on the knee for a slog, thick inside edge runs past short fine leg and beats his chase and dive
backs away to leg and swipes a full delivery square
good length legbreak slapped to the sweeper
on target around off again, and dives to stop the push down the pitch
right on off stump, on a good length, defended to the bowler
gets the line right finally, good length close to off, pushed back
Uthappa has done Dinda a favour here, it was one more length ball on the pads, and was flying fine, but Uthappa put in the dive in time
length on middle and leg now, he goes through midwicket now, there is a man in the deep to cut it off
Dinda starts with a length ball on the pads, and is tucked away to the deep backward square leg rope
waits on this tossed up ball to spin in, and nudges it square
flighted and turning in outside off, defended
good length and flat again, worked to long on
spins in again, good length and flat though, and he quickly opens up to whip it past square leg, well played
tossed up full and turns in to strike the pad on the forward push, going down leg
gets across and dabs one going away to the third man rope
good length on off, swatted through square leg
this one's in the same gap too, he had to reach out for this overpitched ball and timed it better
drilled between long off and extra cover, Rahul Sharma clumsily tumbles to his left, takes pace off it, and seems to have hurt his shoulder
pitched up on off, defended to the bowler
good length now, angled in again, and turned through square leg
overpitched and angled in on the stumps, he leans across and works through midwicket
thick edge again as he pushes forward to a length delivery, races between the slips, and into the third man boundary
flat, quick and short, he reaches out to cut to sweeper cover
straight length ball outside off, he pushes it back
flighted full, and driven wide of sweeper cover
almost another one, thick edge falls just short of slip as he pushes forward
needs one ball to strike, good length and skidding in, Mahmood forward and pushes way outside the line, hit in front of off and given, no issues with that
turned behind square leg off the pads
swings in big time on off stump, off the inner part of the bat to midwicket
pitched up outside off, left alone
Gilchrist lasts three balls, Bhuvneshwar angles it across widish, Gilchrist throws his bat at it, and thick edges to the keeper, decision time for him now
short of a length on the pads, and he's picked it over square leg
length ball moving across, pushed down the pitch
